ck: ranasupa_07 ( ra . ) yatu vastuvastu neyan srutirnuktavisaya tasninapatacivatvavyapya srotriyatvatarnatipavat satakunitaprakrtanantasya tatatkanahatasrotriye asanpavat akanahatatvan visesanan catasya katatereva svatoskanahatatvat tatranantaprasaktya srotriyatvavisesanan akanahatatva sanucitan srotriyatvanevoktasatakunanantasya prayocakaniti sityartan srotriyatvakanahatatvayosanucayartascakara iti kantanan_07 (kan . ) tatra kanahatatvan nana tatatkananayan catayan tatvisayalapaprayuktatryatavatvan tatapava akanahatatvan kinva trsna (kana ) pava etatupayatnakakanahatatvasya patatcivasansarini kanyananavastuna alapena kanananavarcaniyatvena ca asanpavena prhataranyopanisati anantataratanyaprakarana eva srotriyovrcinokanahata iti avrcinatva visesena " satu yuvatyayaka" iti srotriyatvavrcinatve krhyete iti tEtiriyasankarapasye srotriyatvavrcinatve tve (10) iti suresvarakrtatEtiriyapasyavartikepi asninapi prakarane avrcinatvan svikartavyanityuktatvena ca avrcinatvasyapi akanahatatvativat visesanatvavakate sarvapapapavartakavrcinatva visesanasya patacive katancitapi asanpavena ca avrcinatvativisesananan nuktatvavyapyataya patacivatvavirotitaya casya sruternuktavisayatvat satakunitaprakrtanantasya tatatkanahatasrotriyesanpavat akanahatatva visesana niti vakyena srotriyatvasyEva satakunitaprakrtanantaprayocakatvankikare tatatkanahatasrotriyasyapi tatatanantaprasankavaranartan akanahatatva visesananiti prayocanakatananasankataneva intraracatipatakananarahitasrotriyasyapi intraracatisanpantisukanupavasyatarsanena tatviparitatarsanena ca akanahatatvasanhitasrotriyatvasya uktasatakunanantan prati prayocakatvasanpavat
